# Test Action lockfiles

https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-14-github-actions-workflow-lockfiles-in-public-preview/

https://github.com/github/gh-actions-lock

Install the extension.

```sh
gh extension install github/gh-actions-lock
```

Lock.

```sh
gh actions-lock
```

```sh
✓ Pinned 1 action across 1 workflow
    actions/checkout@v7.0.1 (3d3c42e)
      └─ .github/workflows/test.yaml
```

Then `.github/workflows/actions.lock` is created.

```
# This file is machine-generated by `gh actions-lock`.
# Do not edit by hand; run `gh actions-lock` to update.
# Docs: https://gh.io/actions-lockfile
version: 'v0.0.3'
workflows:
    '.github/workflows/test.yaml':
        - 'actions/checkout@v7.0.1'
dependencies:
    'actions/checkout@v7.0.1':
        ref: 'v7.0.1'
        commit: 'sha1-3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1'
        owner_id: 44036562
        repo_id: 197814629
```

Succeeded. https://github.com/szksh-lab-2/test-action-lockfile/actions/runs/38720718412/job/116374301698?pr=1
